title: 一万亿美元订单在手：英伟达需求，居然还超供给
speaker: Bloomberg

segments.en: What was your initial reaction, Antoine?
segments.zh: 安托万，你最初的反应是什么？

segments.en: I mean, thanks for having me on the show. I mean, I think it's just reassuring, you know, an execution.
segments.zh: 感谢邀请。我认为这令人安心，体现了执行力。

segments.en: You have demand, the exceeding supply. You have a stronger guide that simply tells us that Nvidia can keep delivering more systems than expected.
segments.zh: 需求超过供应，指引更强，说明英伟达能持续交付超预期的系统。

segments.en: And more generally, I think that supports our view that near-term, the operations are resilient.
segments.zh: 总体而言，这支持我们认为近期运营具有韧性的观点。

segments.en: So we know Nvidia has $1 trillion or a book, you know, for Blackwell and Rubin.
segments.zh: 我们知道英伟达在Blackwell和Rubin上有1万亿美元的订单储备。

segments.en: I think, you know, that all the turmoil that we've seen recently isn't going to impact the near-term.
segments.zh: 我认为近期市场波动不会影响短期表现。

segments.en: So now what I want to hear about is probably some information that we're going to get on the call is, you know, for example, whether Nvidia will maintain
segments.zh: 现在我想从电话会中听到的是，例如英伟达是否会维持

segments.en: in support for the wider ecosystem, you know, does the commitment to open models remaining back, you know, with audience?
segments.zh: 对更广泛生态的支持，对开放模型的承诺是否依然坚定。

segments.en: And does the kind of question that's really matter to investors tonight, not just like a beaten race, simply because Nvidia could exceed the number of servers
segments.zh: 今晚对市场参与者真正重要的问题，不仅仅是英伟达能超出服务器数量

segments.en: they could get out of the fab space. Do you have confidence in some of the longer-term forecasts?
segments.zh: 他们能从晶圆厂获得的产能。你对一些长期预测有信心吗？

segments.en: I know these weren't hard forecasts that Jensen Wang gave, but they certainly were guidance for Wall Street.
segments.zh: 我知道这些不是黄仁勋给出的硬性预测，但无疑是给华尔街的指引。

segments.en: And guidance had certainly provided a big boost not only to its stock, but of course, to the broader AI ecosystem.
segments.zh: 而指引无疑给其股价带来了巨大提振，当然也给更广泛的AI生态系统带来了提振。

segments.en: Looking out, past 2027, 2028, 2029, even in 2030, he talked about.
segments.zh: 展望2027年之后，2028年、2029年，甚至2030年，他谈到了。

segments.en: Are you still confident in those numbers?
segments.zh: 你对这些数字还有信心吗？
